citations.claim: Step 65 was NS yellow with EW red, so no all-red had started yet
First all_red_clearance violation: E turned green at step 66 after 0s all-red (need 4s), while emergency active
W also turned green at step 66 after 0s all-red due to same emergency preemption

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (W at t=66, duration 1) – with no preemption the cycle proceeds NS yellow -> all-red (4s) -> EW green, so all_red_clearance is satisfied

explanation: Emergency preemption on W at t=66 immediately forces EW green while NS was still in yellow (step 65) and then green before that, skipping the required 4s all-red clearance and truncating yellow to 1s. The controller does not insert yellow+all-red when emergency becomes active; it jumps directly to the emergency direction green, violating all_red_clearance (0s instead of 4s) and also yellow_duration.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 4 s)

vision_note: At step 65 the intersection shows yellow on one axis (top-left and bottom-right) while the opposite axis is red, but at step 66 the opposite axis is already green with no intermediate frame where all approaches are red. The yellow therefore lasts only a single step before the conflicting direction turns green, visibly skipping the clearance interval.
